name: Hannah
source:
A computer whiz and a lover of oriental art, Hannah one day dreams of becoming a full time artist. Although the art she's most interested in is hentai!

Hannah is shy and careful, but she likes to watch and take pictures. And what she sees makes her take risks no girl should ever take in public.

Hannah is obsessed with the female form, always seeking out the perfect glimpse at the most beautiful of subjects. She calls it inspiration, even if others call it perversion.

[From [url=https://www.dumbkoala.art/MeetTheCast/info.php?name=Hannah]DumbKoala[/url]]
